prospective_generation_contract.classification: Source-backed policy decision for later native implementation; not an executable publisher or accepted-job evidence
prospective_generation_contract.admission: Native session-owned effect admits bounded work with current source digest/revision, access/audience generation, index generation and run/job/basis fence; before-admission cancellation returns discard
prospective_generation_contract.ownership: Accepted work belongs to session/run independent of requester disconnect; explicit owner cancellation, termination and shutdown outcomes apply; late results must pass current run/job fence
prospective_generation_contract.summary_acceptance: Revalidate source hashes, visibility and version before accepting consolidation; stale completion cannot overwrite newer episodes or become canonical truth; contradictory source claims are rejected/quarantined without world-fact changes
prospective_generation_contract.index_publication: Native publisher validates current source/access generation and atomically switches derived generation; stale/revoked rebuild is discarded and cannot replace prior valid publication
prospective_generation_contract.read: Native indexed access filters before selection and checks returned rows again; optional missing/stale index uses bounded canonical fallback or explicit Incomplete coverage, never unbounded scan
prospective_generation_contract.return_commit_projection: Ranking does not grant future disclosure/commit; engine/session owner rechecks current basis/source/access before commit or projection
prospective_generation_contract.replay_restart: Replay loads recorded canonical episodes/summaries and performs no summary/embedding/index regeneration or paid calls; absent optional index is explicit and rebuildable; restarted scope enforces current deletion/suppression tombstones
